<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Under one event law, retaining and releasing a coupling have identical marginal possibilities, while retention preserves every represented joint bundle and adds the full bundle. Feeding this structural output into explicit comparison principle C excludes any irreflexive comparator over a summary fully determined by those marginals. A joint-bundle description distinguishes the case; richer possibility still does not force joint actualization.

Canonical source: [Bundles.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Bundles.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Reuses JointContinuationClassification's common initial configuration, event law and stable claim meanings; these supply a local relational representation, not a universal physics derived from nothing.
- The comparison obstruction explicitly assumes this application of GenerativeComparison.ComparisonPrinciple C. Only a bundle containing both represented realizations is marked generative; the label does not warrant its favorable meaning.
- The summary is determined solely by all marginal possibilities and its comparator is irreflexive; additive scores, totality and transitivity are not required.
- Ethical application still requires warrant that the actual joint capacity realizes a favorable living possibility and adequately covers relevant costs, losses and other changes.

Retention and release concern a coupling within one unfolding; left and right are differentiated positions within it. jointInventory.realized denotes an actually present joint capacity, not all future outcomes having happened. The formal composition directly uses outputs of the unmigrated JointContinuationClassification module as inputs to C in the unmigrated GenerativeComparison module; it does not import the general practical-judgment or AI-direction modules.

Excludes only strict comparison through the declared summary, not all scalar evaluation or relationally adequate local analysis. It proves neither preservation of every coupling, premise-free C/G0 nor completed universal ethics, and imposes no gate of complete decidable identification or universal recognition.

- retainedLeft is an admissible left-only history under the same law; joint possibility does not force actual joint realization.
